coffees.name: Arabica Peaberry Coffee
coffees.tastingNotes: Soft, smooth, highly aromatic and flavorful; lighter bodied, clean cup. Recommended for French Press or pour-over.

coffees.name: Arabica Plantation -AAA Coffee (Dark Roast)
coffees.tastingNotes: Dark malty notes with buttery smoothness, slight nutty aroma, medium body, mildly acidic. Beans appear oily after roasting.

coffees.name: Arabica French Roast Coffee
coffees.tastingNotes: Overpowering body, dark colour, void of acidity; bold smoky flavor with sweet notes intermingling.

coffees.availability: Animal-printed packs out of stock; shipping in plain stand-up pouches

coffees.name: Oriental Espresso Blend
coffees.tastingNotes: Citrus and spicy aroma, refined acidity, full-bodied, rich bitterness, thick crema. Designed for espresso machines and milk-based drinks.

coffees.name: Robusta Kaapi Royale

origin.region: Mysore, Coorg, Wayanad, Shevaroys, Pulney, Bababudan regions

coffees.tastingNotes: Citrus and spicy aroma, refined acidity, full body; adds body, flavour and crema to blends.

coffees.name: Monsooned Malabar - Arabica AA
coffees.process: Monsooning — sun-dried green beans warehoused on the Malabar coast during the south-west monsoon (June-September)
coffees.tastingNotes: Monsooned flavor, low acidity, mellow taste, golden cup color; notes of spice, mustiness, wood, chocolate and nuts, sweetish finish, rich crema.

coffees.name: Special Blend
coffees.variety: Mix of Arabica Peaberry and Arabica Plantation-AA
coffees.tastingNotes: Medium bodied, deep citrus flavour with spicy highlights, balanced aroma and strength. One of Devan's oldest blends.

coffees.name: Arabica Plantation -AAA - Mysore Nuggets Extra Bold

coffees.name: Devans Premium Blend
coffees.tastingNotes: Woody and earthy Robusta flavors balanced with delicate Arabica smoothness; lower acidity, heavier mouthfeel, dash of acidity.

coffees.name: Black Honey Coffee

coffees.name: Dip n Sip Coffee Bags - Lodhi Blend
coffees.tastingNotes: Medium body, aromatic, citrusy acidity, earthy undertones. Dip-bag format, no equipment required.

coffees.name: Dip n Sip Coffee Bags - Viennese Blend
coffees.tastingNotes: Medium body, aromatic, citrusy acidity, earthy undertones. Dip-bag format, no equipment required.

coffees.name: Celebration Blend

coffees.name: Chicory Powder

coffees.name: Arabica Peaberry Dark Roast Coffee
coffees.tastingNotes: Floral aroma, bright medium-to-full body, void of acidity, chocolaty finish, dark cup color.

coffees.name: Devans Natraj Coffee

coffees.name: Arabica Plantation - AA Coffee
coffees.tastingNotes: Hint of Indian spice and floral notes; moderate acidity, tangy flavor, full body and good strength.

coffees.name: Colombian Arabica Coffee
